description_en: Modifies an automatic snapshot policy, such as the snapshot creation time, repeat date, and retention period
description_zh: 修改一条自动快照策略，例如，快照创建时间点、重复日期、保留时间等
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-auto-snapshot-policy-ex --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-bp12m37ccmxvbmi50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicyEx

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照策略所在的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25530.html to query available automatic snapshot policies
parameters.help_zh: 目标自动快照策略ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25530.html查看您可用的自动快照策略
parameters.name: auto_snapshot_policy_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy. If this parameter is left empty, the name is not modified
parameters.help_zh: 自动快照策略的名称。如果参数为空则代表不修改
parameters.name: auto_snapshot_policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The points in time at which automatic snapshots are created. The time is displayed in UTC+8. Unit: hours. Valid values: 0 to 23, which correspond to the 24 points in time from 00:00 to 23:00. For example, 1 indicates 01:00.

To create multiple automatic snapshots within a day, specify multiple points in time:

You can specify up to 24 points in time.
Specify multiple points in time in a JSON array, such as `"0", "1", … "23"`. Separate the points in time with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
自动快照的创建时间点。使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。取值范围为0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，如1表示01:00。

当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点：

最多传入24个时间点。
多个时间点用一个格式类似`"0", "1", … "23"`的JSON数组表示，时间点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: time_points

parameters.help_en:
The days of the week on which automatic snapshots are created. Unit: days. The cycle is weekly. Valid values: 1 to 7. For example, 1 indicates Monday.

To create multiple automatic snapshots within a week, specify multiple days:

You can specify up to 7 days.
Specify multiple days in a JSON array, such as `"1", "2", … "7"`. Separate the days with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
自动快照的重复日期，单位为天，周期为星期。取值范围为1~7，如1表示周一。

当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点：

最多传入7个时间点。
多个时间点用一个格式类似`"1", "2", … "7"`的JSON数组表示，时间点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: repeat_weekdays

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of automatic snapshots. Unit: days. Valid values:

-1: Automatic snapshots are permanently retained.
1 to 65536: the number of days for which automatic snapshots are retained.

Default value: -1
parameters.help_zh:
自动快照的保留时间，单位为天。取值范围：

-1：永久保存。
1~65536：指定保存天数。

默认值为-1
parameters.name: retention_days

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow automatic cross-region replication.

true: allowed.
false: not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许自动跨地域复制。

true：允许。
false：不允许
parameters.name: enable_cross_region_copy

parameters.help_en: The destination region to which snapshots are replicated. Currently, you can set only one destination region
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域复制快照的目标地域。目前支持设置一个目标地域
parameters.name: target_copy_regions

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of cross-region snapshot replicas. Unit: days. Valid values:

-1: Snapshot replicas are permanently retained.
1 to 65535: the number of days for which snapshot replicas are retained.

Default value: -1
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域复制快照的保留时间，单位为天。取值范围：

-1：永久保存。
1~65535：指定保存天数。

默认值为-1
parameters.name: copied_snapshots_retention_days

true: Encryption is enabled.

Default value: false

true：是。 
false：否。 

默认值：false

fields.help_zh: 快照跨地域加密复制使用的 KMS 密钥 ID
fields.name: kms_key_id

parameters.help_en: The encryption parameter object for cross-region snapshot replication
parameters.help_zh: 快照跨地域复制加密参数对象
parameters.name: copy_encryption_configuration

fields.help_en:
The tag key.
Valid values of N: 1 to 10.
The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
标签键。
N 的取值范围：1~10。
一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以 aliyun 或 acs:开头，不能包含 http:// 或 https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.
Valid values of N: 1 to 10. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://.
Note: If you pass in an empty value or an empty string, it indicates any value
fields.help_zh:
标签值。
N 的取值范围：1~10。最多支持 128 个字符，不能包含 http:// 或 https://。
说明 如果传入空或空字符串，则表示任意值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The list of target resource tags. The automatic snapshot policy matches target resources based on tags.
This parameter is required when AssociationType is set to AssociatedWithInstanceTag
parameters.help_zh:
目标资源标签列表。自动快照策略根据标签匹配目标资源。
当 AssociationType=AssociatedWithInstanceTag 时，该参数为必填
parameters.name: target_tags
